summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the 4-11 Studio coming-soon page. All backend /api/subscribe endpoints and the full UI (loader, hero, countdown, subscribe form, socials) pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Old /api/briefs endpoints remain in server.py but are unused by the current UI. Consider removing or gating them if no longer needed.
Loader.jsx duration is fine but relies on wall-clock setTimeout fallback; consider a small integration test for background-tab timer throttling if this ever ships.
seed_data_creation: Test emails prefixed with test_/ui_ + uuid/timestamp; stored in db.subscribers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_subscribe.py cover subscribe happy path, duplicate 409, invalid 422, count baseline & increment. Frontend Playwright verified loader (data-testid=loader/loader-pct) detaches, all data-testids present (brand-logo, countdown-timer, subscribe-form/email/submit, social-instagram), countdown shows non-zero values, empty submit shows error toast, valid submit shows success toast and clears input, Instagram href = https://www.instagram.com/4eleven.in/.
